differences_from_design: The manifest holds per-file symbol ranges, not per-symbol counts, and acceptance 7 forbids new stored data. Count is therefore derived by reading only the symbol column of pruned row groups, cached per date against the manifest signature: the first call for a symbol set is cold (about 0.6 s here), repeats are cache hits.
Count is closes present, not proven contiguous; the min_closes join still checks contiguity at read time.
